data.rationale: The proposal captures the right procedure (Find a Park by State, choose a state, click a park's info or heritage-area link), but it merges park and section into one vague parameter, adds an unneeded "open home page" step, and says "scroll to the target park or section" without saying how to locate it, so an automation would need guesswork.
